calculation_quotes: DIRECT-ICE-CY2025: $527,827,186.25 GEO parent + $171,510,932.72 B.I. = $699,338,118.97 action-date obligations across 124 actions.
ICE-REVENUE-POINT: $2,631,549,000 x 47.6% = $1,252,617,324; this is a point estimate from a reported rounded share.
CONTEXT-RATIO: $699,338,118.97 / $1,252,617,324 = 55.8301%; the $553,279,205.03 arithmetic difference is not attributable to IGSAs or any facility.
SEC-INTERNAL-CHECK: 2.6% BOP + 47.6% ICE + 15.9% USMS = 66.1%, not the 66.6% aggregate printed in the same paragraph.
115 GEO parent actions totaling $527,827,186.25 + 9 B.I. actions totaling $171,510,932.72 = 124 CY2025 ICE actions totaling $699,338,118.97.
$508,878,952.25 detention + $9,414,567.00 transportation/removal + $9,533,667.00 other/unresolved + $159,536,432.72 ISAP/electronic monitoring + $11,974,500.00 skip tracing = $699,338,118.97.
Six CY2025 B.I. actions classified ICE ISAP/electronic monitoring sum to $159,536,432.72; three skip-tracing actions sum to $11,974,500.00.
$699,338,118.97 / $1,252,617,324 = 55.8301%; the $553,279,205.03 arithmetic difference is not attributable to IGSAs or any facility.
